plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 25% of the book, to favor income and stability.
Increase QQQ to 25% for additional broad index exposure and quality.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Reduce SPY to 25% to cure concentration and meet the mandate.
Buy MRVL, a high-scoring scanner setup, for 4% of the book.
Increase QQQ to 20% to maintain broad index exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately 2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality tech name. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of stability and growth potential.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.
Add to SOXL, targeting 6%, and SPAL, targeting 6%, to increase leveraged exposure.
Buy MRVL for 6% of the book, leveraging a high-scoring tech setup.
Buy TECL for 5% of the book, adding another high-scoring leveraged tech ETF.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware of substantially higher volatility, larger potential drawdowns, and the daily decay/rebalancing effects of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to prioritize income distributions.
Trim QQQ to 10% to reduce growth exposure and reallocate to income.
This plan focuses on generating steady monthly distributions.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It significantly reduces leverage and high-beta names, favoring income-generating ETFs. While aiming for steady distributions, remember these are variable, and NAV can still decline in market downturns. This is not a savings account.
